profile: AC1018 ET-Drawing-with-Border STANDARD MLINESTYLE to AC1024 DXF

authoritative_format_source.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, v5.4.1
authoritative_format_source.relevant_layout: The MLINESTYLE body stores name, description, flags, fill CMC, start/end angles, line count and per-line offset/color/linetype index for pre-R2018. Its trailing handle references are parenthandle, reactors, then xdicobjhandle.

independent_source_evidence.reference: The independent decoded source records bind the one STANDARD MLINESTYLE to its soft-owned ACAD_MLINESTYLE dictionary entry and bind both owner/reactor routes.

qualified_scope.style: One AC1018 STANDARD MLINESTYLE, handle 0x18, two elements at offsets +0.5 and -0.5, BYLAYER colors, and the built-in linetype index 32767.
qualified_scope.graph: The staged-output inspector verifies the NOD ACAD_MLINESTYLE edge, root DICTIONARY owner and Standard membership, MLINESTYLE handle and dictionary owner, reactor roles, and exact supported style fields. Fresh DXF import verifies one typed MLINESTYLE and its two BYLAYER elements.
qualified_scope.opaque_callback_count: The source has 23 callbacks. This profile raises output-qualified identities from 4 to 5; the other 18 remain unqualified.
qualified_scope.legacy_frame_boundary: The AC1018 opaque callback frame carries identity/type/version but no validated common-link fields (owner=0, common-link evidence Unknown). Admission relies on the typed MLINESTYLE owner/reactor fields, the independently decoded dictionary graph above, and staged output inspection. AC1024 sources continue to require validated common-link evidence on the frame.

failure_and_retry.test_isolation: The test-only source model assigns a valid temporary name to unrelated empty-name STYLE 0xDF so TABLES emission can reach the MLINESTYLE OBJECTS profile. It does not establish whole-source conversion or STYLE omission.
failure_and_retry.invalid_linetype: A mutated ordinary linetype index is refused without replacing a pre-existing destination or publishing callback qualification.
failure_and_retry.retry: After restoring the source linetype index, the same adapter emits ASCII and Binary outputs, freshly imports each output, and publishes qualification for source callback 0x18.

implementation.behavior: The existing single-STANDARD output profile now admits AC1018 and AC1024 DWG sources for AC1024 DXF output. For AC1018 only, an Unknown/empty callback-frame common-link projection is accepted when the typed source graph closes the owner/reactor relationship; the AC1024 frame evidence requirements are unchanged.
implementation.fixture_policy: No DWG or DXF fixture files were added.

limits: This qualifies one STANDARD MLINESTYLE graph profile for the exact AC1018 source and AC1024 ASCII/Binary output.
The empty-name STYLE remains refused; the production writer does not omit or remap it.
Strict whole-source conversion remains refused because 18 of 23 callback identities are unqualified.
This receipt does not establish native CAD semantics, whole-document conversion, other MLINESTYLE profiles, other source versions, 3D support, or any public support claim.
next_action: Continue qualifying the remaining AC1018 callback identities from source-required rooted profiles. Keep unknown callbacks refused and the empty-name STYLE disposition separate.
